newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse ends slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse ends slightly lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 0.30 percent in thin trade after Wednesday's closure for Women's day, bourse sources said
The 31-share index closed at 439.72 points, down from 441.04 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 342,247 dinars against 260,517 dinars.
Tunisian real estate firm Societe Immobiliere et de Participation SIMPAR fell 1.78 dinar to 20.52 dinars with only 66 shares changing hands. Chemical firm Alkimia was down 0.84 dinar to 42.26 dinars.
Banque du Sud slid 0.58 dinar to 10.25 dinars with the exchange of 14,047 shares.
Retail stores Monoprix eased 0.5 dinar to 31.5 dinars.
Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie edged lower 0.5 dinar to 40 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole declined 0.1 dinar to 18.5.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing was down 0.1 dinar to 30.5 dinars.
Banque Nationale de Developpement Touristique was up 0.2 dinar to 8.39 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF rose 0.12 dinar to 13.9 dinars. 0.2 dinar to 8.39 dinars.
